# Hand Joints

To make it easier for you to mix-and-match our different examples, this template has been converted to an importable asset in the [Asset Library](/lens-studio/assets-pipeline/asset-library/asset-library-overview.md) with the name `2D Hand Tracking Joints`.

The Hand Joints template allows you to attach different screen effects to 25 joints found on the hand, as well as to create triggers with your own custom hand gestures.

[](/img/lens-studio/hand-joints_preview_opt.webm)

## Video Walkthrough[​**](#video-walkthrough "Copy to clipboard")

## Template Walkthrough[​**](#template-walkthrough "Copy to clipboard")

### Hand Tracking Joints[​**](#hand-tracking-joints "Copy to clipboard")

The Hand Joints Template provides 25 2D screen points that represent joints on the hand. You can find all of the joint objects under the Hand Tracking Controller object.

These joints are referenced in the `HandTrackingController` script under the `Advanced` section and its relationship to each other is used to calculate the current “gesture” of the hand

![](data:image/png;base64,)

![](/assets/images/hand-joints_hand-tracking-joints-97ab9fcc8c2c883cfad03d203641e7c6.png)

Each joint uses the same Object Tracking component used in pet, shoulder, and body tracking

To attach mesh or images to a certain joint, just put the object as their child or use [Pin to Mesh](https://lensstudio.snapchat.com/guides/3d/pin-to-mesh/) to connect them to the joint.

You can see an example of  how joints are tracked by turning on the joint debug view. To do this just enable Debug Joints object.

![](/assets/images/hand-joints_debug-joints-object-e7c8c446e2b8502c7c8c6125a4e9185e.png)

### Hand Triggers[​**](#hand-triggers "Copy to clipboard")

By knowing the position of each hand joint, we can understand how the user’s hand is shaped. We can use this to detect a “hand gesture” that the user is doing in order to trigger an effect.

Let’s take a look at the `Hand Trigger` script to see this in action.

#### Using Custom Gestures[​**](#using-custom-gestures "Copy to clipboard")

Disable `Is Default Gesture` flag in `HandTrigger` script to show the `Custom Gesture` option. It allows you to specify name of any gesture that is stored in `HandGesturesController` script.

![](/assets/images/hand-joints_three-fingers-gesture-inspector-8013b908c64889d4f8bab2a01e5c9b84.png)

![](/assets/images/hand-joints_hand-gestures-library-7255afaf0a3d1049799e4abc6b75d510.png)

To add a custom gesture, tap the preview screen at the moment you see the gesture to detect, and the Lens will print out the relative position of the joints to the `Logger` panel.

[](/img/lens-studio/hand-joints_tap-to-get-custom-gesture-opt.webm)

Then you can copy that line to HandGestureLibrary and name your new custom gesture!

This is the same technique found in the [Full Body Trigger](/lens-studio/features/ar-tracking/body/body-templates/full-body-triggers.md) template

### Default Gestures[​**](#default-gestures "Copy to clipboard")

For convenience, you can also detect the built in gestures using same script. When `Is Default Gesture` is selected you’ll see menu with all available options.

[](/img/lens-studio/hand-joints_default-gesture-opt.webm)

### Adding trigger response[​**](#adding-trigger-response "Copy to clipboard")

Now when your trigger is bound to default or custom gesture, you can specify trigger response. In this template we use [Behavior Scripts](/lens-studio/lens-studio-workflow/adding-interactivity/behavior.md) to do so.

![](/assets/images/hand-joints_three-fingers-gesture-inspector-8013b908c64889d4f8bab2a01e5c9b84.png)

**Response On Start:** name of Behavior Custom Trigger to be called when gesture is detected

**Response On End:** name of Behavior Custom Trigger  to be called when gesture is no longer detected

You can find `On Start` and `On End` objects with attached Behavior scripts under each Hand Trigger object.

![](data:image/png;base64,)

![](/assets/images/hand-joints_behavior-objects-2b87961969cd26bb14d3daf15e2ecd6d.png)

The advantage of using Behavior scripts is having a very wide range selection of responses and having delays to the trigger as well.

To learn more about Behavior script, check out the official [Behavior Script guide](/lens-studio/lens-studio-workflow/adding-interactivity/behavior.md)!

### Hand Segmentation[​**](#hand-segmentation "Copy to clipboard")

Feel free to mix and match this technique with other capabilities. The Hand Joints Template also comes with a segmented Hand Mask image for you to use! To preview it just enable `Hand Mask` object in `Scene Hierarchy` panel.

![](/assets/images/hand-joints_hand-mask-object-0273c547f9f54b9a3f89989903c244b9.png)

[](/img/lens-studio/hand-joints_hand_mask_opt.webm)

### Switching Preview Video[​**](#switching-preview-video "Copy to clipboard")

When working with this Template, you’ll want to switch the preview video to one with a person’s hand. In the Preview panel, select the Image / Video Mode button.

![](/assets/images/hand-joints_switch-preview-26aa661fcf4ef9a1010b79fc8429d933.png)

Record your own videos or make photos and set them as a Lens Studio preview by clicking on `+` From Files button at the bottom of the preview panel dropdown list.

## Previewing Your Lens[​**](#previewing-your-lens "Copy to clipboard")

You’re now ready to preview your Lens! To preview your Lens in Snapchat, follow the [Pairing to Snapchat](/lens-studio/lens-studio-workflow/pairing-to-snapchat.md) guide.
